title: This Seal Shakes Penguins Right Out of Their Skin

scenes.text: This seal shakes penguins right out of their skin.
It's a leopard seal, and it patrols the water where penguins enter the sea.
It ambushes the young ones as they leave or return to the water.
Then it shakes the bird at the surface until the skin comes off.
Its jaws open 160 degrees, and it swims at up to 25 miles an hour.
It's the only seal known to hunt both penguins and other seals' pups.

description:
This seal shakes penguins right out of their skin.
Leopard seals ambush penguins at the water's edge, and their jaws open 160 degrees. They are the only seals known to hunt both penguins and seal pups.
Would you swim there? Comment below.
first_comment: The leopard seal is the only seal known to hunt both penguins and other seals' pups. What animal would you least want to meet in the water?
